name: Burundi (1966–1967)
description: A white saltire dividing the field into red triangles at the top and bottom and green triangles at the hoist and fly, with a white disc in the centre bearing a red sorghum plant.
history: After the monarchy was abolished on 28 November 1966 the karyenda drum was removed from the central disc of the 1962 flag, leaving only the sorghum plant. The three stars of the national motto 'Unité, Travail, Progrès' replaced the sorghum on 28 June 1967.
